result.summary: Found 3 issues: critical content cutoff in the 'Popular right now' section, major text truncation in the restaurant list, and a major layout overlap with the navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant name for the second 'Popular right now' card (showing pizza with -100% label) is completely cut off and not visible. Users cannot identify which restaurant this is.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout to ensure restaurant names are fully visible above or below the images, or reduce image height to accommodate text within the viewport.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right edge. The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated (likely should be 'Trattoria Piccola').
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel cards are fully visible within the screen width, or implement proper text truncation with ellipsis (...) to indicate incomplete text.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in 'Popular right now' overlaps with the bottom navigation bar, making content partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content area to ensure the last card has adequate spacing above the fixed navigation bar.
